settings.title: Who we are
settings.body: RYVT LLC, Metro Detroit, Michigan. These terms cover every order placed through this store.

settings.title: Orders
settings.body: An order is an offer to buy. It is accepted when we dispatch it, and we may decline one before then.

settings.title: Prices
settings.body: Prices are in US dollars and exclude tax, which is calculated at checkout.

settings.title: Payment
settings.body: Payment is handled by Shopify. We never see or store your card details.

settings.title: Delivery
settings.body: Title and risk pass to you on delivery. Shipping timescales are estimates, not guarantees.

settings.title: Returns
settings.body: Thirty days from delivery, unworn with tags on. Faulty goods are covered separately by law.

settings.title: Liability
settings.body: Our total liability for any order is limited to the amount you paid for it. Nothing here limits liability that cannot be limited by law.

settings.title: Changes
settings.body: We may update these terms. The version in force is the one published when you order.

settings.title: Law
settings.body: Michigan law applies, and the Michigan courts have jurisdiction.

settings.heading: Terms of Service
settings.lede: The agreement between you and RYVT when you buy from this store.
